items.caption: ciorbă și ingredient opțional
items.rationale: Rice is a recognizable shared ingredient and optional explicitly avoids claiming that every meatball-soup recipe must use it. The relation remains clear in reverse traversal.

items.caption: ciorbă și carnea din perișoare
items.rationale: The phrase says where the meat belongs inside the dish: its meatballs. This explains the soup-to-ingredient jump instead of merely repeating that two concepts are connected.

items.caption: sarmale și orezul din umplutură
items.rationale: Naming rice as filling tells the player the actual culinary role linking these concepts. It is an ordinary recipe association and remains orientation-independent.

items.caption: sarmale și carnea din umplutură
items.rationale: The filling phrase identifies the canonical meat-filled preparation represented by this edge, without claiming that vegetarian variants cannot exist. The displayed relation is useful in either direction.

items.caption: formațiune stâncoasă și munți
items.rationale: Natural rock formation distinguishes the Sphinx from an artificially carved statue or the nearby built cross. Mountain context explains its link to Bucegi without reversing location.

items.caption: monument și munții unde se află
items.rationale: Built monument and mountain location are explicit. The noun phrase distinguishes the cross from the natural rock formations in the same route.

items.caption: formațiuni stâncoase vecine
items.rationale: Neighboring rock formations is a recognizable and specific relation. It explains why Babele and the Sphinx connect without turning one into the creator, container or synonym of the other.

items.caption: stânci și monument din Bucegi
items.rationale: The repaired phrase identifies both the natural rocks and the built monument and their shared Bucegi setting. It avoids the unsupported precision of locating the cross literally on the plateau; the monument owner places it on the secondary Caraiman peak. This is clearer and accurate at the granularity of the existing association.

checks.route_coverage: All eight uncaptained edges across the four V94 shortest routes.

resolved_findings.resolution: Replaced the plateau-specific caption with rocks and monument sharing the Bucegi setting.

limits: Bounded semantic and exact-edge review. It does not establish human enjoyment or physical-device readability.
